paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Huna; another version has Kuna. In Bekhorot, chapter Ad Kamma, Rabbah, Rav Yosef, and four hundred pairs of rabbis wished to ask him laws, etc. But the reading before us is Rav Huna bar Chiyya; see there.
